gates.requirement: Isolated generated source and provenance exist, are original, and match one named inventory member.
Retopologized LOD0 stays within its source archetype triangle cap.
LOD1 and LOD2 preserve silhouette and socket planes and are not raw generator output.
Straight, rotated, corner, T, and loop assemblies pass source gap and overlap tolerances.
Simplified collision is separate from render meshes and portal-state collision updates atomically.
End-to-end mixed navigation, infantry branches, portal updates, and deterministic rubble are measured.
Authored destruction swaps and explicit source-to-topology state mappings update collision and navigation without physics fragments becoming authority.
XS and SMALL assemblies meet their source triangle and draw-call budgets before batching.
Portrait and landscape tactical/close captures prove cutaway, objective, clearance, and shimmer quality.

sourceAcceptanceGates: Every pack remains PLANNED and runtimeReady false until generated sources, provenance, optimizer output, socket assembly, collision, nav, and device captures pass.
Each Hunyuan generation is one isolated named asset; a generated scene or combined kit is rejected because dimensions, pivots, sockets, collision, and LODs cannot be verified independently.
Generated LOD0 is retopologized to the archetype triangle cap; LOD1 and LOD2 preserve silhouette and socket planes and are not raw Hunyuan outputs.
Every 4 m and 8 m socket assembly passes straight, rotated, corner, T, and loop tests with no visible gap above 0.02 m and no collision overlap above 0.05 m.
Every XS and SMALL map preserves an end-to-end route for infantry, one small vehicle, and one mech; infantry-only branches may enrich but never define the only objective route.
Door and gate intact, open, jammed, and destroyed states update collision and navigation atomically.
Destructible cover uses authored deterministic state swaps; no physics fragments become navigation authority.
An assembled XS scene at LOD0 stays below 180000 visible triangles and 90 draw calls before batching; an assembled SMALL scene stays below 320000 visible triangles and 140 draw calls before batching.
Mobile portrait and landscape captures at tactical and close zoom show readable objectives, vehicle clearances, nonrepeating landmark identity, and no cutaway occlusion or micro-detail shimmer.

No generated asset may reproduce franchise logos, recognizable copyrighted models, or source-image pixels; cited games contribute only high-level silhouette, modularity, and tactical-readability principles.

assemblyRules: One continuous 8 m-module route connects insertion, objective, and extraction for one small vehicle or one mech.
